messages:
Mia Chen: Hey team — CloudCo asked for a hands-on iac playground next week to validate our marketplace packaging + terraform modules. Thinking a 90min workshop + a repo with 3 example stacks (GKE, EKS, Baremetal) and a CI smoke test.
Jordan Patel: +1. can we make the modules provider-agnostic where possible? keep provider-specific bits in examples.
Samir Rao: Agreed. Also suggest we include a sample `quantized` model serving module and a tiny perf test harness (requests per minute).
Mia Chen: Good call. For terraform, propose module layout: modules/refarch/{network,compute,serving,monitoring} and examples/<cloud> that wire them.
Liam O'Connor: I can own the CI job templates. Will add a `validate-and-smoke` GH workflow that runs `terraform init && terraform validate && ./smoke.sh`.
Olivia (BizDev): Anita (CloudCo) — is there anything specific you want in the packaging for marketplace listing? licensing? install UX?
Anita - CloudCo: We need a single-click deploy experience in the marketplace console and clear output on cost estimate. Also small deployment footprint (<= 4 vCPU) for the demo.
Mia Chen: Noted. We'll provide a marketplace manifest + a tiny demo profile. We'll also expose variables for instance size.
Samir Rao: Draft terraform module snippet for common serving layer: 
```
module "redwood_serving" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood/refarch.git//modules/serving"
  model_bucket = var.model_bucket
  instance_type = var.instance_type
  enable_kv_cache = true
}
```
Jordan Patel: Let's add a `prepack` script to zip the module and generate a Mercado/Marketplace manifest. We should version modules semantically.
Liam O'Connor: CI snippet (draft): 
```yaml
name: Validate & Smoke
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Terraform Init
        run: terraform -chdir=examples/gcp init -input=false
      - name: Validate
        run: terraform -chdir=examples/gcp validate
      - name: Smoke
        run: ./examples/gcp/smoke.sh || (echo "smoke failed" && exit 1)
```
Olivia (BizDev): We'll need a one-pager for partners with screenshots and a checklist for marketplace submission. I can assemble if you give me artifacts.
Mia Chen: I'll add example manifests + sample cost estimate screenshots. Samir can add the perf harness outputs.
Samir Rao: I'll wire a small load script and include sample results in `docs/perf/`. Keep it <5k tokens in the demo prompt to keep latency down.
Anita - CloudCo: Awesome. Can we schedule a dry-run with CloudCo engineers two days before the partner workshop?
Mia Chen: Yes — propose dry-run on Tue 10am PT, workshop Thu 3pm PT. Anyone blocked?
Jordan Patel: I'm good.
Liam O'Connor: free.
Olivia (BizDev): works for me.
Samir Rao: OK. I'll push the module skeleton today and open a PR.
deploy-bot: CI: build succeeded for branch `feature/partner-iac-playground` (job #342) :white_check_mark:
Mia Chen: Nice, thanks. Next step: PR with modules + examples, Olivia gets assets, schedule invites for dry-run. I'll post a short agenda and checklist later today. :thumbsup:
